text:
olivia_cs: Flagging Springboard — active seat count down ~69% over last 11 days. Champion (Avery) left last Tue. Procurement shared a shortlist that includes VendorNimbus. Looks like a renewal risk.

mark_csm: when's their renewal? any billing or SSO churn?

olivia_cs: Renewal 24 days out. Billing clean. CRM shows Avery removed; new contact is Raj but no reply to outreach.

deepak_eng: any infra/telemetry anomalies? 5xxs, 429s, latency?

olivia_cs: No errors. Biggest drop is in nightly embedding jobs and webhook ingest.

alerts-bot: Reminder: renewal-30d alert triggered for account springboard. Assigned to @sara_rev and @mark_csm.

sara_rev: looping in renewals — if procurement is comparing VendorNimbus we should try tight commercial: 6-week pilot + targeted credits and an Optimize quickscan. Need current vs committed tiers and top endpoints.

mark_csm: Proposed playbook: 1) 48h personalized outreach + small credit 2) tech healthcall with Deepak 3) short pilot/ROI one-pager from Sara. Agree? :thinking_face:

olivia_cs: +1. also request top-10 endpoints, last-30d seat churn, and recent deploy notes. I'll add to CRM.

deepak_eng: I'll pull token/endpoint breakdown and p50/p95 latency. Can demo a quant+batch config that reduced unit cost ~25% for a similar customer. Need 48h to collect traces.

sara_rev: I'll draft a 3-month constrained pilot one-pager (conditional on modest usage commitment) and a conservative competitor-cost slide. Need usage delta and top endpoints.

mark_csm: I'll schedule outreach tomorrow afternoon and lead the contact. Olivia, you update CRM and tag account as "at-risk: renewal window". Deepak & Sara, have materials ready by EOD Wed.

olivia_cs: Updated CRM and logged actions. Outreach scheduled. Raj auto-replied OOO but said they'd be back next Monday.

alerts-bot: Actions recorded: outreach scheduled, tech healthcall prep, pilot deck draft.

deepak_eng: quick note — please capture sample payloads for their top embedding flow. will need to sanitize before using in demo.

olivia_cs: adding sample payload ask to CRM. also saw procurement message asking for "cost per 1k tokens" and "p95 latency" in vendor comparison.

sara_rev: include a slide with cost bands at 50k/200k/1M tokens and p50/p95 latency. we'll offer a short credit to cover migration testing.

mark_csm: update — Raj accepted a quick sync for Thu AM. He confirmed procurement is collecting comparisons but is open to a short pilot if we can show net cost wins and similar latency.

olivia_cs: Great. After the call, we'll push a tailored Optimize quickscan and the pilot one-pager. If they ask for formal RFP pricing, escalate.

mark_csm: aim: convert this into a limited pilot vs full RFP. move fast. :pray:

olivia_cs: Will post meeting notes and next steps after Thu. tagging this thread as the single source of truth for the runbook. :white_check_mark:
